name: o67599

schema.title: Cookie
schema.description: A Cookie, that follows the [Google Chrome format](https://developer.chrome.com/extensions/cookies)

domain.description: The domain for which this cookie is valid.

hostOnly.description: True if the cookie is a host-only cookie. (i.e. a request's URL domain must exactly match the domain of the cookie).

httpOnly.description: Indicates if this cookie is HTTP Only. (if True, the cookie is inaccessible to client-side scripts)

name.description: This is the name of the Cookie.

path.description: The path associated with the Cookie.

secure.description: Indicates if the 'secure' flag is set on the Cookie, meaning that it is transmitted over secure connections only. (typically HTTPS)

session.description: True if the cookie is a session cookie.

extensions.description: Custom attributes for a cookie go here, such as the [Priority Field](https://code.google.com/p/chromium/issues/detail?id=232693)

description:
The authentication cookie **session_id** is set for the domain **.example.com** and applies to the root path **/**. Its value is **e3f2c1a9b4d6f7a8c9e0d1b2c3a4f5e6** and it is marked as both **HttpOnly** and **Secure**, so it will only be sent over HTTPS connections and cannot be accessed via client‑side scripts. The cookie is not a host‑only cookie (the domain does not have to match exactly) and it is not a session‑only cookie; instead it carries an explicit expiration at Unix timestamp **1924992000** and a Max‑Age of **86400** seconds.  

Additional attributes have been attached to the cookie: it carries a **Priority=high** flag and enforces a **SameSite=Strict** policy. These custom extensions ensure the cookie is treated with higher priority by the browser and is sent only in first‑party contexts.
